evidence_contract.closure_method: Verify prior 34-route packet + prove real NFL Slate surface markers + prove V236 NFL Receptions through real UI.
evidence_contract.receptions_failure: UI selection commits to NFL + Receptions but no route body renders on V235
evidence_contract.branch_acceptance: V236 static + branch-local real UI Receptions proof
evidence_contract.production_acceptance: public real UI Receptions proof after merge
evidence_contract.slate_acceptance_v2: Public route must render both 'NFL slate date' and 'Verified NFL schedule' with no forbidden runtime marker.
evidence_contract.deployment_activation: On main push, wait up to 300s for public V236 Receptions fail-closed surface before public closure checks.
evidence_contract.slate_branch_acceptance: Branch-local Slate must render `NFL slate date` plus `Verified NFL schedule` or `NFL build status`.
evidence_contract.slate_public_acceptance: After V236 deployment activation, public Slate must render the real Slate surface; up to 3 bounded retries are allowed only for transient Streamlit navigation/runtime errors.
evidence_contract.receptions_public_acceptance: After V236 deployment activation, public real UI flow NFL -> Receptions must render the V236 fail-closed route body.
evidence_contract.last_public_runtime_failure: Platform-level `This app has encountered an error` during immediate post-merge Slate check before Receptions proof.
evidence_contract.deployment_refresh_method: app.py heartbeat revision using established repository Streamlit Cloud refresh pattern
evidence_contract.deployment_refresh_acceptance: After merge, public descendant runtime must expose V236 Receptions fail-closed surface and targeted Step 4/5 proof must emit all four freeze tokens.

patch.behavior: Intercept only NFL -> Receptions for reliable fail-closed route rendering from UI selection or existing category-jump query. Delegate all other routes to frozen V235.

followup_patch.behavior: Recognize the actual NFL Slate production markers without changing product/runtime behavior.

deployment_refresh_patch.behavior: Force Streamlit Cloud to restart and consume already-merged V237 -> V236 runtime. No runtime behavior change.
